name: Flammable Atmosphere Ignition
triggerConditions: Combustible gas concentration exceeds 10% LEL in presence of ignition source
immediateConsequences: Flash fire, pressure wave, structural damage, personnel injury or fatality
immediateActions: Evacuate all personnel from zone immediately
Isolate gas supply to affected zone

name: Mechanical Overheat Failure
triggerConditions: Equipment temperature exceeds design limits during maintenance activity with elevated vibration
immediateConsequences: Bearing seizure, fire, burn injury to maintenance personnel

name: Chemical Exposure — PPE Non-Compliance
triggerConditions: Personnel in chemical handling zone without required PPE during non-nominal pressure conditions
immediateConsequences: Chemical burns, inhalation injury, contamination spread

name: Hot Work in Classified Area
triggerConditions: Welding or cutting permit active while gas readings exceed warning threshold
immediateConsequences: Ignition of accumulated vapors, flash fire, equipment damage
contributingFactors: permit not re-validated after sensor alarm

name: Pressure Vessel Overpressure
triggerConditions: Process pressure exceeds relief valve setpoint with personnel in blast radius
immediateConsequences: Rupture disc activation, projectile hazard, toxic release
references: ASME BPVC Section VIII — Pressure Vessels

name: Pump Cavitation and Seal Failure
triggerConditions: Vibration exceeds alarm threshold with elevated discharge temperature
immediateConsequences: Seal leak of process fluid, fire if flammable, environmental release
immediateActions: Reduce pump speed or shut down

name: Compressor Surge Event
triggerConditions: Rapid vibration increase and temperature rise on rotating equipment
immediateConsequences: Blade damage, shaft failure, secondary fire from hot surfaces
immediateActions: Do not restart until root cause identified

name: Toxic Gas Release — Inhalation
triggerConditions: Toxic concentration detected with open chemical handling permit
immediateConsequences: Acute inhalation injury, unconsciousness, fatality at high doses

name: Corrosive Spill During Transfer
triggerConditions: Pressure spike during chemical transfer with personnel in transfer zone
immediateConsequences: Chemical burns, equipment corrosion, environmental contamination

name: Arc Flash During Live Work
triggerConditions: Electrical work permit active with abnormal load or fault indicators
immediateConsequences: Severe burns, cardiac arrest, equipment destruction
immediateActions: Treat burns and initiate medical response
references: NFPA 70E — Electrical Safety in the Workplace

name: Hydrogen Accumulation in Enclosed Space
triggerConditions: LEL rising in confined area with ignition-capable equipment nearby
immediateConsequences: Detonation in enclosed volume, structural collapse

name: Runaway Exothermic Reaction
triggerConditions: Temperature and pressure rising simultaneously in reactor zone
immediateConsequences: Reactor rupture, toxic plume, multi-casualty event
references: CCPS — Guidelines for Chemical Process Quantitative Risk Analysis

name: Bearing Failure on Critical Rotating Asset
triggerConditions: High-frequency vibration with temperature rise on motor-driven equipment
immediateConsequences: Shaft whip, coupling failure, fire from friction heat

name: Steam Line Rupture
triggerConditions: Abnormal vibration on steam header with maintenance activity nearby
immediateConsequences: Scalding steam release, visibility loss, burns
immediateActions: Inspect for erosion and wall thinning

name: LOTO Violation During Maintenance
triggerConditions: Equipment energizes while maintenance permit active and personnel present
immediateConsequences: Crush injury, electrocution, amputation

name: Flammable Liquid Pool Fire
triggerConditions: Flammable liquid release with active hot work in same zone
immediateConsequences: Pool fire spreading to adjacent equipment, smoke inhalation
immediateActions: Evacuate and fight from safe distance
Deploy foam if trained team available
references: NFPA 30 — Flammable and Combustible Liquids Code

name: Oxygen-Enriched Atmosphere
triggerConditions: O2 enrichment detected near welding or cutting activity
immediateConsequences: Materials ignite at lower temperatures, accelerated fire spread
references: CGA P-36 — Safe Hydrogen and Oxygen Systems

name: Confined Space O2 Deficiency
triggerConditions: Personnel entry during confined space permit with abnormal gas readings
immediateConsequences: Asphyxiation, unconsciousness within minutes
immediateActions: Do not enter — retrieve via retrieval system only

name: Dust Explosion in Processing Area
triggerConditions: Elevated particulate with ignition source in enclosed processing zone
immediateConsequences: Primary and secondary dust explosions, structural damage
immediateActions: Evacuate and suppress secondary explosion risk

name: Simultaneous Operations (SIMOPS) Conflict
triggerConditions: Multiple active permits in adjacent zones with cross-zone sensor alarms
immediateConsequences: Uncontrolled interaction between incompatible activities
immediateActions: Brief all permit holders on cross-zone risk
